description.en: Workspace-based archive management with scoped content search, conversation previews, tags and notes, ZIP backups, lineage graphs, confirmed permanent deletion and retries, and official Host updates. Declares DeepSeek Harness >=0.1.0-rc.7 || 0.2.2-rc.1 || 0.2.2-rc.2; older supported Hosts can update directly.
description.zh: 按工作区管理已归档与未归档会话，支持独立范围正文搜索、上下文预览、标签备注、ZIP 备份导入导出、会话谱系、永久删除确认与失败重试，以及官方宿主更新。声明支持 DeepSeek Harness >=0.1.0-rc.7 || 0.2.2-rc.1 || 0.2.2-rc.2，受支持的旧版宿主可直接升级插件。
